name: Hash lookup
intuition: Write down what you have seen in a map or set, so every later question is answered in one step instead of a search.

variants.name: Seen before?
variants.summary: Keep a set of what has appeared; a repeat or a missing neighbour is found in one lookup.
variants.requires: Items can be compared for exact equality.

variants.name: Find a partner
variants.summary: For each item, look up the partner it needs, then write the item down.
variants.requires: The partner is fully determined by the item, such as target minus value.

variants.name: Count and compare
variants.summary: Tally how often each item appears, then compare or rank the tallies.
variants.requires: Each item has a simple key, such as the letter itself.

variants.name: Group by a signature
variants.summary: Give every item a key that equal items share, and collect items under their key.
variants.requires: You can compute a signature that is identical exactly when items belong together.

visual.caption: At position 3 the value 7 needs a partner worth 5. One look in the map answers whether 5 has been seen, without scanning earlier values.
